name: Scales of Fate
source:
Five years ago, a renowned cultivator from Qing Shuang Sect named Shen Xiuying had died by drowning in a river.

Nobody knew why he died. Was it suicide? Did somebody murder him in cold blood? It was a mystery to all who heard of this incident.

That is, until “Shen Xiuying” came back... as a yao.

Thus, a mystery from five years ago shall finally unravel itself.

[From [url=https://tsukimii.itch.io/scales-of-fate]itch.io[/url]]
